author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before: a generic open hand with five stubby bumps and no motion lines, so it lost the reference's defining concentric arcs and raised index finger. After: two concentric quarter arcs (r4/r13) in the upper-left corner over a 45-degree thumb, a tall index finger, a middle finger and a palm narrowing to an open wrist; reads as a hand pressing with motion ripples at 48 in both themes.
omissions: Ring and little fingers folded into the palm's right bulge: two arcs plus four 8-wide fingers and a thumb exceed the 40-unit width at 8 spacing.
